# SHANXING Custom PVC Shoe Charms
> Factory-direct custom soft PVC shoe charms from Fujian, China for brands, retailers and promotional buyers.

SHANXING is Shishi Shanxing Plastic Products Factory (石狮市山行塑料制品厂), Room 203, No. 16, Lunhou 1st District, Bao'gai Town, Shishi City, Fujian Province, China. Its house brand is MOCHI CHARMS: https://mochicharms.com/

## Main pages
- [Custom PVC Shoe Charms Manufacturer](https://arismemo.github.io/pvc-shoe-charms-factory/): MOQ, budgetary volume pricing, factory process, quotation inputs and contact details.
- [PVC Shoe Charms Sourcing Guide](https://arismemo.github.io/pvc-shoe-charms-factory/guide.html): materials, mold coordination, production, report scope, samples, packing and shipping.

## Key commercial facts
- Standard starting MOQ: 100 pieces per design.
- Published prices are budgetary EXW Fujian assumptions, not a final quotation.
- Mold, sample, special packing, testing, shipping, duties and taxes are quoted separately unless stated otherwise.
- Mold manufacturing is handled by specialist partners; shoe-charm production and quality checks stay in the SHANXING factory.
- Supplier material test reports are available for scope review; finished-product or batch testing may still be required.
